transcript.title: Transcript

transcript.help: The transcript of every clip on the timeline. Backspace / Delete a word or selection to cut it out of the film (red). Double-click a word to correct its text. Hover a marked word to undo it.
transcript.laneFeedsCaptions: Captions are burnt from this lane.
transcript.insertedWord: Added by you — no audio behind it

captions.translationIsNonDestructive: Translations are stored beside the transcript, never in it — the original text and its timings stay untouched.
captions.anchorHintBottom: Long captions grow upward — the bottom edge stays put.
captions.derivedFromTranscript: {{count}} caption lines, derived live from the transcript.
captions.hiddenHint: Captions come from this media's transcript. Turn them on to see them in the preview and in exports.
captions.noTranscript: Captions are read from the media transcript. Transcribe this video to turn them on.
captions.translateHint: Translate the transcript with the configured AI provider
captions.anchorHintTop: Long captions grow downward — the top edge stays put.

speed.selectRegion: Select a speed region to adjust
speed.previewFrameSteppingHint: Above {{native}}×, preview is frame-stepped and muted. Export is unaffected.

audioTrack.slipHint: Alt-drag to slide the audio inside it
audioTrack.help: Volume, fades and looping for this audio track. It mixes over the recording in the preview and the export. A music track dips on its own while someone speaks. Drag the track on the timeline to move or resize it, or hold Alt and drag to slide the audio inside it.

layout.help: How the webcam is composed with the screen: picture-in-picture, vertical stack, dual frame, shape, roundness, size, position, and mirroring.
layout.webcamFramingDrag: Drag the frame to move it, or a corner to zoom.
layout.reactiveWebcamDescription: Camera smoothly shrinks while the video is zoomed in, so it stays out of the way.
layout.helpNoWebcam: This project has no camera, so the layout controls are off and the preset reads “No webcam”. Your saved layout is kept for when a camera is added.
layout.title: Camera layout

crop.title: Crop
crop.dragInstruction: Drag on each side to adjust the crop area

focusMode.lockedDisclaimer: Set by the Auto-Focus button in the timeline. Turn it off to choose the focus mode of each zoom.
focusMode.autoDescription: Camera follows the recorded cursor position
focusMode.title: Focus mode

camera.title: 3D camera

description.left: Holds one pose: turned left and seen from above.
description.right: Holds one pose: turned right and seen from above.
description.followCursor: The screen stays still; the camera circles it, swinging to the cursor's side and rising or dipping with it.

camera.needsCursor: The cursor is hidden: this camera has nothing to follow and holds its starting angle.

clickImpact.title: Click impact
clickImpact.description: Each click presses the tilted screen: the clicked side dips, then springs back.
clickImpact.needsRotation: Pick a 3D camera first: only a tilted screen can be pressed.
clickImpact.needsCursor: The cursor is hidden: the screen only reacts to clicks you can see.
clickImpact.descriptionCamera: Each click pushes the camera back a little, then it springs forward.
